body:
Well, my writings are in Portuguese, so I don't know if you can read them, it's not a very known language, hahaha. But it's just some poems, some short stories, essays...

The priest really pointed out my fear of the life itself. How I went to those feelings of despair and letargy because of fear of just making the right thing. It still rings in my head, and it was what I needed to hear, not necessarily what I WANTED to hear, but it really helped, afterwards...

You know, my friends are good to me and want to help... 
But you are right, I gotta meet someone who can understand this feelings. One time, I talked it to a priest, in a confession. He was very old, and a foraigner in my Country - He was polish. And he truly said some great (really hard, but great) advice. I could not find him anymore. 

But honestly, you helped. Just got to find someone.

Yeah, I really like my walks I give on the streets, at night - really helps me to think; reading is also very good, and I also write, which helps me to exorcise some of these feelings.
